_note: Defaults for every domain's LLM-as-Judge run. Per-domain overrides go in config/judge/<domain>.json and carry ONLY the fields that differ; the `release` and `calibration` blocks merge per key, so overriding one field there keeps the rest of the block.

calibration._note: Section 10.2 acceptance protocol. min_anchors and agreement_pct are fixed by the Execution Scope (>=10 anchors per domain, within +-1 on >=90% per dimension) — they live here to be reviewable without reading Python, not because they are ours to tune.
calibration._gate_note: Two gates, both OPT-IN. require_calibration is the SCORING gate: set it true for a domain and an LLM run refuses that domain until a passing marker exists. Left false, runs proceed and no flag is needed. --allow-uncalibrated still works and is then a no-op.
calibration._release_note: require_calibration_for_release is the RELEASE gate, FALSE by project decision: a --release scorecard and its immutable baseline can be produced before the calibration session happens. A deliberate departure from Section 10.2's last line, recorded here rather than buried in code. What is NOT configurable is the labelling — every artifact still records calibrated state, so a baseline established this way can never be mistaken for a calibrated one.
